text_block_list.text:
During training in the mountains,
I suddenly felt unsteady on my feet.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
? What's up, Trainer?
You seem a bit down?
choice_data_list: No, I'm just a little tired, that's all.

text_block_list.text:
Thinking a little rest would be enough,
we continued training for the time being, but—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you okay?
Your face is completely pale.

Sitting on a tree stump, I manage a slight nod.
Should I have her head down the mountain first?
Just as I was thinking that...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's head down the mountain.
It'll be getting dark soon.
choice_data_list: You want to carry me on your back!?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you can't move, right?
It might shake a bit, but I won't drop you.
Just count the clouds or something.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mmm!
Today was such a fun day.

In the end, I was carried on Mr. C.B.'s back
all the way down the mountain...
choice_data_list: I'm sorry for causing you trouble...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hm? You didn't make a fuss at all,
weren't you actually a really good kid?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: More importantly, giving someone a piggyback ride is pretty fun!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Stepping on the ground without shaking,
and maintaining balance across stepping stones...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Was it because I was paying attention to so many things?
I feel like my senses have gotten incredibly sharp!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, let me carry you on my back again!
Next time, we'll climb a mountain like that.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"When that time comes, we can add a bit more weight...
Maybe I could even carry a bag of rice on my back!"

From this day on, Mr. C.B.'s running
was polished to an even greater sheen!
